docs: backfill 2.15.1 security entry in changelog and readme

The 2.15.1 security fix (user enumeration via the deprecated
`SendPasswordResetEmailPayload.user` field, GHSA-jhh7-832h-f8hv) was merged via
the advisory's private fork as a squashed "Merge commit from fork" — a
non-conventional message — so release-please could not auto-generate a changelog
entry for it.

Backfills the already-released 2.15.1 section of CHANGELOG.md and readme.txt with
a Security entry, and adds a 2.15.1 Upgrade Notice so WordPress.org prompts users
to update. Docs-only; does not trigger a release.

revision_candidates.message:
Isolate TurnServer datagram and message processing from the receive loops

A UDP datagram arriving on the TURN port is unauthenticated and arbitrary, and
the STUN parser throws on input it does not recognise. HandleUdpDatagram was
called inside the receive loop but outside any per datagram handler, with the
generic catch sitting outside the loop, so a throw unwound past the loop and
ended it. ReceiveUdpAsync is started fire and forget by Start() with no
supervision, so nothing restarted it: the UDP relay stayed down for every
client until the process was restarted.

Two ways in, both verified. A first byte with bits set that the STUN header
check rejects and which is not channel data throws ApplicationException from
STUNHeader.ParseSTUNHeader. A datagram too short to hold a STUN header but
starting with an accepted first byte gets a null header back from
ParseSTUNHeader, which STUNMessage.ParseSTUNMessage then dereferences for the
message length, throwing NullReferenceException. Only t

Isolate TurnServer datagram and message processing from the receive loops (#1774)

A UDP datagram arriving on the TURN port is unauthenticated and arbitrary, and
the STUN parser throws on input it does not recognise. HandleUdpDatagram was
called inside the receive loop but outside any per datagram handler, with the
generic catch sitting outside the loop, so a throw unwound past the loop and
ended it. ReceiveUdpAsync is started fire and forget by Start() with no
supervision, so nothing restarted it: the UDP relay stayed down for every
client until the process was restarted.

Two ways in, both verified. A first byte with bits set that the STUN header
check rejects and which is not channel data throws ApplicationException from
STUNHeader.ParseSTUNHeader. A datagram too short to hold a STUN header but
starting with an accepted first byte gets a null header back from
ParseSTUNHeader, which STUNMessage.ParseSTUNMessage then dereferences for the
message length, throwing NullReferenceException

revision_candidates.message: Merge branch 'main' into 3595-fix-postMessage-security

Harden message origin checks and rich-text URL sanitization (#7056)

## Summary

This PR hardens several trusted-boundary checks across the TinaCMS
packages.

It includes four focused changes:

1. Adds origin/source validation to the `useTina` overlay message
handler.
2. Adds origin/source validation to the OAuth popup message handler.
3. Adds origin/source validation and explicit `targetOrigin` handling to
the `@tinacms/app` GraphQL reducer preview channel.
4. Applies URL sanitization to slatejson rich-text parsing and adds
render-side URL sanitization for default rich-text link/image rendering.

## Changes

- Rejects unexpected `message` events before reading `event.data`.
- Checks both origin and source window where the expected peer window is
known.
- Replaces loose preview `postMessage` calls with explicit target
origins.
- Sanitizes rich-text link and image URLs during slatejson parsing.
- Keeps render-side URL sanitization as a defense-in-depth layer.

issue_or_pull_snapshots.title: fix: race in Diff mode crashes Hoverfly (GHSA-qrh4-p6v4-mrfg)

revision_candidates.message:
fix(diff): guard responsesDiff with RWMutex (GHSA-qrh4-p6v4-mrfg)

Diff mode's responsesDiff map had no synchronization, so concurrent
proxy requests tripped Go's built-in concurrent-map check and crashed
the process with "fatal error: concurrent map read and map write".

Add a dedicated sync.RWMutex covering AddDiff, ClearDiff, GetDiff, and
GetFilteredDiff. GetDiff now returns a deep snapshot so DiffHandler can
iterate the result outside the lock without re-introducing the race.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>

issue_or_pull_snapshots.title: ECOPROJECT-4724 | fix: Escape SQL string fields in query builder to prevent second-order SQL injection

revision_candidates.message:
ECOPROJECT-4724 | fix: Escape SQL string fields in query builder to prevent second-order SQL injection

Cluster names from user-uploaded RVTools spreadsheets were interpolated
unescaped into ~27 DuckDB query templates via text/template, allowing
single-quote breakout and arbitrary SQL execution (e.g. read_text() for
file exfiltration). Apply escapeSQLString() to all user-controlled
queryParams fields (ClusterFilter, OSFilter, PowerStateFilter, VmIDFilter,
Category) before template execution.

Signed-off-by: Aviel Segev <asegev@redhat.com>

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        token = response.json().get("token")
        self.assertIsNotNone(token)
        self.assertTrue(_verify_and_consume_ws_token(set(), token))
